# Slidenav

<p class="gls-text-lead">Defines navigation with previous and next buttons to flip through slideshows.</p>

## Usage

To create navigation with previous and next buttons, just add the `gls-slidenav` attribute to `<a>` elements. Add the `previous` or `next` parameter to the attribute to style the nav items as previous or next buttons.

```html
<a href="" gls-slidenav-next></a>
<a href="" gls-slidenav-previous></a>
```

<div class="gls-docs-example">
<a href="#" gls-slidenav-previous></a>
<a href="#" gls-slidenav-next></a>
</div>

```html
<a href="#" gls-slidenav-previous></a>
<a href="#" gls-slidenav-next></a>
```

***

## Large modifier

To increase the size of the slidenav icons, add the `.gls-slidenav-large` class.

```html
<a href="" class="gls-slidenav-large" gls-slidenav-next></a>
<a href="" class="gls-slidenav-large" gls-slidenav-previous></a>
```

<div class="gls-docs-example">
<a href="#" class="gls-slidenav-large" gls-slidenav-previous></a>
<a href="#" class="gls-slidenav-large" gls-slidenav-next></a>
</div>

```html
<a href="#" class="gls-slidenav-large" gls-slidenav-previous></a>
<a href="#" class="gls-slidenav-large" gls-slidenav-next></a>
```

***

## Slidenav container

To display a conjoint slidenav, wrap the slidenav items inside a `<div>` element and add the `.gls-slidenav-container` class, as well as one of the `.gls-position-*` classes.

```html
<div class="gls-slidenav-container">
    <a href="" gls-slidenav-previous></a>
    <a href="" gls-slidenav-next></a>
</div>
```

<div class="gls-docs-example">
<div class="gls-slidenav-container">
    <a href="" gls-slidenav-previous></a>
    <a href="" gls-slidenav-next></a>
</div>
</div>

```html
<div class="gls-slidenav-container">
    <a href="" gls-slidenav-previous></a>
    <a href="" gls-slidenav-next></a>
</div>
```

***

## Position as overlay

To position the slidenav on top of an element or the [Slideshow component](https://getuikit.com/docs/slideshow) for example, just add one of the `.gls-position-*` classes from the [Position component](https://getuikit.com/docs/position). To create a position context on the container, add the `.gls-position-relative` class.

Use the `.gls-light` or `.gls-dark` class from the [Inverse component](https://getuikit.com/docs/inverse) to apply a light or dark color for better visibility.

```html
<div class="gls-position-relative gls-light">

    <!-- The element which is wrapped goes here -->

    <a class="gls-position-center-left" href="" gls-slidenav-previous></a>
    <a class="gls-position-center-right" href="" gls-slidenav-next></a>

</div>
```

**Note** You can also apply the [Visibility component](https://getuikit.com/docs/visibility#toggle), so that the slidenav only appears on hover.

<div class="gls-docs-example">
<div class="gls-position-relative gls-visible-toggle gls-light" tabindex="-1" gls-slideshow>

    <div class="gls-slideshow-items">
        <div>
            <img src="images/photo.jpg" alt="" gls-cover>
        </div>
        <div>
            <img src="images/dark.jpg" alt="" gls-cover>
        </div>
        <div>
            <img src="images/light.jpg" alt="" gls-cover>
        </div>
    </div>

    <a class="gls-slidenav-large gls-position-center-left gls-position-small gls-hidden-hover" href="#" gls-slidenav-previous gls-slideshow-item="previous"></a>
    <a class="gls-slidenav-large gls-position-center-right gls-position-small gls-hidden-hover" href="#" gls-slidenav-next gls-slideshow-item="next"></a>

</div>
</div>

```html
<div class="gls-position-relative gls-visible-toggle gls-light" tabindex="-1" gls-slideshow>

    <div class="gls-slideshow-items">
        <div>
            <img src="images/photo.jpg" alt="" gls-cover>
        </div>
        <div>
            <img src="images/dark.jpg" alt="" gls-cover>
        </div>
        <div>
            <img src="images/light.jpg" alt="" gls-cover>
        </div>
    </div>

    <a class="gls-slidenav-large gls-position-center-left gls-position-small gls-hidden-hover" href="#" gls-slidenav-previous gls-slideshow-item="previous"></a>
    <a class="gls-slidenav-large gls-position-center-right gls-position-small gls-hidden-hover" href="#" gls-slidenav-next gls-slideshow-item="next"></a>

</div>
```
